text.msed.hud.double_tap_rec: Press the record key again to start recording
text.msed.hud.start_failed: Recording could not start; the game log says why.
text.msed.hud.writer_failed: Ticks are no longer being saved, for example because the disk is full; the game log says why. Stop the recording.
text.msed.hud.ffmpeg_missing: §e[MSED]§r Video disabled: FFmpeg not found. Structured state is still recorded. Install FFmpeg with §b%s§r, then restart the game.
text.autoconfig.msed.title: MSED Configuration
text.autoconfig.msed.option.filesystem.d: Folder where episodes are written, relative to the game directory.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.recordingBeh: Countdown between pressing the record key and the first recorded tick.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.ffmpeg.execu: Full path to ffmpeg. Leave empty to find it automatically (PATH and common install locations). Restart the game after changing.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.ffmpeg.autoD: Test the available encoders (GPU first) and use the first one that works on this machine.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.ffmpeg.video: Encoder used when auto-detection is off, for example libx264.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.ffmpeg.prese: Encoder preset used when auto-detection is off. Leave empty for the encoder default.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.ffmpeg.fps.t: Frame rate written to the video files. Keep at 20 so one frame matches one game tick.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.advanced.tic: Number of ticks written to each shard file before a new one is started.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.advanced.wri: Ticks that can wait for the disk writer. When full, ticks are dropped and logged instead of slowing the game.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.vision.rgbWi: Width of the recorded video frames in pixels.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.vision.rgbHe: Height of the recorded video frames in pixels.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.vision.nonTr: Horizontal number of rays for the pass that stops at the first opaque block.
Vertical number of rays for the pass that stops at the first opaque block.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.vision.trans: Horizontal number of rays for the pass that also stops at transparent blocks (grass, water, glass).
Vertical number of rays for the pass that also stops at transparent blocks (grass, water, glass).
text.autoconfig.msed.option.vision.fovea: 1.0 spaces rays evenly. Higher values concentrate rays toward the center of the view.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.recording.re: Records the final frame, including HUD and open screens (gui.mp4).
Records the world before the hand and HUD are drawn (world.mp4).
Block ID and distance per ray, stopping at the first opaque block (glass, leaves, plants and fluids are seen through).
Block ID and distance per ray, stopping at the first visible block (grass, water surface, glass).
Distinct blocks hit by any ray, sorted by distance.
Every sound played during the tick: sound ID, volume and position.
Position, velocity, health, armor, experience, on ground, sneaking, sprinting and fall distance.
Light level at the player and time of day.
Items in the main hand and off hand.
Whether a block is being mined, progress, speed, harvestability and target position.
Active effects with amplifier and remaining duration.
Entities within 16 blocks: type, position, velocity, rotation and dropped item.
The 9 hotbar slots and the selected slot.
The open screen, every slot and its contents, cursor position and hovered slot.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.metadata.tas: Free text saved with each episode, for example what the player was asked to do.
text.autoconfig.msed.option.metadata.ena: Keep the same anonymous user ID across game restarts (stored in config/msed_user.id). Otherwise a new ID is generated on every start.
